name: Overlord Mok'Morokk's Concern
summary: Overlord Mok'Morokk sends you south from Brackenwall Village to recover what he left at the Stonemaul clan's old home. He wants his grog, snuff and strongbox back.

sections.title: The Overlord's Story
sections.body: Mok'Morokk says Rexxar made him the mighty leader of the Stonemaul clan. He says he keeps his people safe. When big dragons came to the clan's old home and brought fire, he found them a new home here in Dustwallow.

sections.title: Things Left Behind
sections.body: Mok'Morokk left the old home in such a hurry that he forgot his grog, snuff and strongbox. He points you south to the Den of Flame and the Stonemaul Ruins, certain his things are there. He says he is too busy leading the ogres to go himself.

faq.answer: Overlord Mok'Morokk leads the Stonemaul clan from Brackenwall Village. He says Rexxar made him its mighty leader.

faq.q: What happened to the Stonemaul clan's old home?
faq.answer: Mok'Morokk says big dragons came to the Stonemaul clan's old home and brought fire. So he found the clan a new home in Brackenwall Village.
Mok'Morokk wants his grog, snuff and strongbox back. He forgot them when he left the old home in a hurry.
Mok'Morokk sends you south, certain his belongings are in the Den of Flame and the Stonemaul Ruins.

faq.q: Why doesn't Mok'Morokk fetch his things himself?
faq.answer: Mok'Morokk says he is too busy leading the ogres to fetch his things himself.
